The protected landing preview loads Tubes Cursor by Kevin Levron (soju22).
Runtime: threejs-components 0.0.19, loaded from jsDelivr.
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/threejs-components@0.0.19/build/cursors/tubes1.min.js

The author's demo identifies the effect as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0:
https://codepen.io/soju22/pen/qEbdVjK
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/

Credit: Kevin Levron, Tubes Cursor.
The runtime remains unmodified and is not included in the Projection UI npm package.
The preview supplies theme colors and pointer input through an isolated frame.
